text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: We did it! We really beat that<n>super-strong team!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That means we're also super strong,<n>right? Hehe!
♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If we keep this up, maybe we can win<n>next time,
too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, what am I saying? We will winagain!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Right! And everyone on our team<n>seems just as
motivated!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Next up... we have to face Team<n>Zenith!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little surprised that I'm not<n>feeling nervous. If
anything, I'm so<n>excited, I could take off running
right<n>here and now!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Let's give the final showdown all<n>we've got!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...Huh. Who'd have thought theycould beat a team that good.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Don't let it get to you! We're plenty<n>determined
ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
As long as we stay resolved and<n>keep our noses to
the grindstone,<n>we'll get faster and faster!
